proposed_fixes.title: PowerToys intermittently fails to stay running at Windows startup
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The startup task may launch the runner before required elevated/module initialization completes, or the runner may exit during startup; the report spans auto-start and early process exit.
plan: Trace runner startup and exit on cold logon for per-user and machine-wide installs, including elevated startup.
Apply a narrow retry/delay or startup-state correction only after identifying the failing transition.
Add a startup regression test covering tray-only launch and runner survival.
verification: Cold-logon with Run at startup enabled and verify PowerToys stays resident without a manual launch or duplicate shortcut.

comment.body: Thanks for sharing the `-tray-only` Startup-folder workaround and noting that it works for you. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version and whether the built-in startup toggle still fails? If it does, please say whether PowerToys never appears in Task Manager or appears and then exits, and whether “Always run as administrator” is enabled. That separates task registration from a startup crash without asking for the same workaround again.
